scenario: [LNUL.4.2]'s `not`, all three cells: `not true = false`, `not false = true`, `not null = null`. One P fact holds t = true, f = false and n = null. Each cell X is two rules: `X` fires only when X is true, and `not (X)` fires only when X is false, so a null cell fires neither and every cell's value is read off which of its pair fires. `not_t_not` and `not_f` fire; `not_n` and `not_n_not` fire neither, which `dead_rules_expected` requires. A runtime reading `not null` as `true` fires `not_n`; one reading null as false fires `not_n_not`. Agenda order is source order ([LDET.5.4]), so `expected_rule_names` lists the firing rules in that order. Path: each `where` is one join test over a slot (a bare Bool slot is no comparison with a literal, so nothing hoists); libds's rete/eval.c DS_RETE_UNOP_NOT arm, Mercury's ds.eval ev_node(e_unop(...)).
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    id: String key
    t: Bool mutable
    f: Bool mutable
    n: Bool? mutable

rule not_t:
    P p where not p.t
->
    log info "not_t"

rule not_t_not:
    P p where not (not p.t)
->
    log info "not_t_not"

rule not_f:
    P p where not p.f
->
    log info "not_f"

rule not_f_not:
    P p where not (not p.f)
->
    log info "not_f_not"

rule not_n:
    P p where not p.n
->
    log info "not_n"

rule not_n_not:
    P p where not (not p.n)
->
    log info "not_n_not"
